features.name: rectangular enclosed arena
features.quote: The arena floor should be approximately 200x200 studs.

features.name: tall boundary walls
features.quote: surrounded by tall boundary walls (about 30 studs tall)

features.name: central multi level tower
features.notes: At heart of arena; focal point

features.name: tower open doorways
features.quote: with stairs, open doorways, and multiple levels

features.name: tower internal stairs
features.quote: internal stairs and enclosed upper levels to hide on

features.name: enclosed tower upper levels
features.quote: enclosed upper levels to hide on

features.name: warm brown crate clusters
features.notes: At least 15-20 crates and boxes; stacked 2-3 high; distributed across arena
features.quote: Multiple clusters of stacked crates and boxes of different sizes, some stacked 2-3 high. Use warm brown colors. Include at least 15-20 crate instances

features.name: gray stone pillars
features.quote: Several large pillars and columns scattered around the arena (8-12 pillars). Use gray stone color.

features.name: blue gray partition maze
features.notes: At least 10-15 low wall segments; creates small rooms and corridors
features.quote: Low partition walls creating small rooms and corridors in a maze-like layout.

features.name: narrow maze passages
features.notes: With open areas and blind corners
features.quote: The layout should feel like a maze with narrow passages, open areas, and plenty of blind corners.

features.name: raised wood platforms
features.notes: Different heights; some with stairs or ramps
features.quote: Ramps and raised platforms at different heights for vertical gameplay. Some with stairs or ramps leading up. Use wood-like brown color.

features.name: spherical bushes rocks planters
features.notes: At least 10-15 scattered elements; green bushes and gray rocks
features.quote: Large spherical bushes, rocks, and planters scattered around. Use green for bushes, gray for rocks. Include at least 10-15 foliage elements.

features.name: dense arena obstacle field
features.quote: Overall there should be 50+ objects distributed across the arena
